module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  bump_left,
    input  bump_right,
    output reg walk_left,
    output reg walk_right
);
    reg [1:0] state, next_state;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'b01;
        else state <= next_state;
    end
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            2'b01: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; next_state = bump_left ? 2'b10 : 2'b01; end
            2'b10: begin walk_left = 0; walk_right = 1; next_state = bump_right ? 2'b01 : 2'b10; end
            default: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; next_state = 2'b01; end
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module TopModule(input  clk, input  areset, input  bump_left, input  bump_right, output reg walk_left, output reg walk_right);
  reg [1:0] state, nextstate;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
    else state <= nextstate;
  end
  always @(state or bump_left or bump_right) begin
    case (state)
      2'b00: begin walk_left <= 1; walk_right <= 0; nextstate = bump_right ? 2'b01 : 2'b00; end
      2'b01: begin walk_left <= 0; walk_right <= 1; nextstate = bump_left  ? 2'b00 : 2'b01; end
      default: begin walk_left <= 0; walk_right <= 0; nextstate = 2'b00; end
    endcase
  end
endmodule
